summary_for_children: Al-Ghashiyah asks us to look at the camel, the sky, the mountains and the earth and think how they were created.
environment_concept: A walk past the four things 88:17-20 asks us to look at: resting camels, a high open lookout for the raised sky, tall mountains standing up from the plain, and a wide flat plain spread out to the horizon. The Day and the Garden described in 88:1-16 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Resting camels, a raised viewing platform, tall peaks, a wide open plain.
